responsibility: Provides miscellaneous C library and OS utility wrappers for the GNU Modula-2 mc bootstrap runtime that do not fit the more focused libc/libm modules. Its entry points expose formatted current time strings, file size and modification time queries via fstat, random-number generation, passwd-based username and uid/gid lookup, and signbit tests for float, double, and long double, plus standard module init/fini hooks.
